title: Transmission and the three regimes
claim: For laws on bits (sets of relations on {0,1}): (1) if every relation is closed under majority, every circuit of every system is a tie, the shape is a flag complex, and there are no knots; (2) at every excluded pattern of a knot each variable is forced to the opposite value; (3) two knots sharing only the distinction e, with e forgotten, form one knot on all their other distinctions when they can force e to opposite values, and a hub otherwise; (4) a knot forces only 0 exactly when it is 'not all on' and only 1 exactly when it is 'not all off'; (5) hence every law is pairwise (no knots), frozen (all knots one-signed of one sign, never composing) or transmitting (knots force both values); (6) in a transmitting law, chains of k knots compose into knots on sum |K_i| - 2(k-1) variables, k + 2 for three-variable knots; (7) laws of negative clauses, implications and unit literals are frozen, and dually. The converses 'every law not closed under majority has a knot' and 'every frozen law is of that kind' are read from Post's lattice and checked on all 273 laws generated by one relation on at most three bits (183 pairwise, 2 frozen, 88 transmitting) and 11 multi-relation laws.
failure_conditions: A knot on three or four variables other than 'not all on' or 'not all off' forces values in one direction only.

A pair of three-variable knots in some placement whose composite is not one knot on the other four when they force the shared distinction oppositely, or not a hub otherwise; or a sampled pair with four-variable knots that breaks the rule.
A transmitting three-variable knot whose chains of 2, 3, 4 copies do not reach knots of 4, 5, 6 variables.
A law generated by one relation on at most three bits, or a catalogued law, whose observed behaviour contradicts its exact class.
foundation_claim_scope: Knots, their composition and their growth in laws on bits. No native recurrence beyond the K1-K3 reading, no space, no metric geometry and no physical claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py examines all 34 three-variable and 742 four-variable knots, all 10,404 placed pairs of three-variable knots and 3,000 sampled pairs with four-variable knots, chains of every transmitting three-variable knot, all 273 laws generated by one relation on at most three bits with exact classes and witnesses, and 11 multi-relation laws; four controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive and randomized checks; Baker and Pixley, Schaefer, resolution, and Post's lattice (for two stated converses, checked on all small laws) are cited; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: the pieces are classical (majority closure, resolution, the implicative hitting-set families); new to the program are the forcing form of the transmission rule for all knots on bits, the identification of frozen knots with 'not all on' and 'not all off', and the three-regime map with growth.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-21.
